what: Only while held, the ring fills over 2.4s (power1.in) and the center core grows up to 3.4×. On release it drains in .8s (power2.out), and when full it fires fx:done and empties in .5s. Keyboard (Space·Enter) is faster at 1.6s. An intended wait, like ”you have to endure thinking time before the answer comes.”

options.dur: Seconds from press to fully filled, default 2.4 — only the remaining portion takes time
options.fast: Duration when pressed by keyboard (sec), default 1.6
options.after: Duration of clearing after full (s), default 0.5
options.[data-fx-part=ring]: Filling SVG ring (circle, path) — measures the length and fills it with dashoffset
options.--fx-hold: A 0 to 1 progress value on the element. Other effects such as blur are applied by the consuming CSS using this value (filter: blur(calc(var(--fx-hold) * 10px)))
options.fx:hold · fx:done: While filling: detail.progress, when full: fx:done (bubbles)
options.aria-disabled=\"true\": If set, it can’t be pressed (e.g. when answers are incomplete)

from.where: index.html .ph-hold__btn (a question whose answer appears when you press and hold)

note: Only the button captures touch (touch-action: none applies only to the button) — don’t make the button as tall as the screen
